message.content: {"hts_code": "4203.30.0000", "reason": "Belts of textile materials combined with plastic (polyurethane) classify under heading 4203 as articles of apparel/clothing accessories of leather or composition leather, and the subheading for belts and bandoliers is 4203.30 covering other articles of apparel and accessories of composition leather or plastic sheeting; however, since the outer layer is polyester textile and not leather or plastic sheeting, the more precise classification is under 6217.10 for made-up clothing accessories of textile fabric, with the belt's construction supporting heading 6217."}

predicted_reason: Belts of textile materials combined with plastic (polyurethane) classify under heading 4203 as articles of apparel/clothing accessories of leather or composition leather, and the subheading for belts and bandoliers is 4203.30 covering other articles of apparel and accessories of composition leather or plastic sheeting; however, since the outer layer is polyester textile and not leather or plastic sheeting, the more precise classification is under 6217.10 for made-up clothing accessories of textile fabric, with the belt's construction supporting heading 6217.
